items.title: Comparative Cost of Care Recommended by Large Language Models versus Treating Physicians
items.excerpt: NEJM AI study evaluating 24 AI models: LLMs are increasingly consulted for clinical decision support, yet the cost of the services or treatment they recommend had not been systematically compared with what treating physicians actually ordered. (Online date verified via Crossref.)

items.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication (AI-INFO)
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article (AI-INFO) testing whether AI-generated summaries of patient documents handed to physicians before the visit change consultation time and patient-physician communication. Abstract behind Cloudflare at collection time; online date verified via Crossref.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction - Development and External Validation
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article developing and externally validating an AI-enhanced (digital stethoscope) auscultation model to flag left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care. Abstract behind Cloudflare at collection time; online date verified via Crossref.

items.title: 씨어스, UAE 아부다비 보건부 IRB 승인… UAE 최초 AI 부정맥 국가검진 사업자 선정
items.excerpt: 씨어스가 UAE 세하클리닉과 추진하는 국가 건강검진 프로젝트로 아부다비 보건부 IRB 승인을 받았다. 40세 이상 자국민 연 1회 국가검진에 웨어러블 AI 부정맥 스크리닝을 도입하기 위한 최종 파일럿이다. (게시일: 본문 '16일 밝혔다' 기준)

items.title: [2026 국감] "AI 시대에 의료영상 삭제, 재산 없앤 셈"…심평원 데이터 관리 도마
items.excerpt: 심평원이 저장공간 부족을 이유로 과거 의료영상 데이터를 삭제하고 삭제 기준·표준화도 갖추지 못한 사실이 16일 보건복지위 국정감사에서 질타를 받았다. 의료 AI 학습용 공공 원천데이터 관리 문제.

items.title: 쓰리빌리언, ASHG 2026서 AI 유전체 해석 기술 등 연구 4건 발표
items.excerpt: AI 기반 희귀질환 진단 기업 쓰리빌리언이 ASHG 2026에서 AI 유전자진단(변이 해석) 기술과 정부 희귀질환 사업 성과 등 4건의 연구 결과를 발표한다. (게시일: 본문 '16일 밝혔다' 기준)

items.title: Radiology department uses AI to identify lung cancer screening patients in EHR
items.excerpt: UC Irvine developed a natural language processing tool that extracts smoking history and identifies lung-cancer-screening-eligible patients from free-text clinical notes.

items.title: Researchers develop way of adapting adult radiology AI models to pediatric population
items.excerpt: Only about 17% of FDA-authorized AI medical devices are labeled for use with children; researchers describe a method to adapt adult radiology AI models to pediatric patients.

items.title: New CPT codes are expanding reimbursement for AI-powered CCTA tools
items.excerpt: New CPT codes for AI-powered coronary CT angiography analysis (plaque, FFR-CT) are changing what clinicians can bill; cardiology is ahead of most specialties on AI reimbursement.

items.title: FDA-cleared cardiothoracic imaging tools being added to popular AI platform
items.excerpt: Riverain Technologies is making its FDA-cleared suite of cardiothoracic CT/X-ray AI tools available through a widely used radiology AI platform, broadening hospital access.

history_match.title: FDA clears AI tool for pediatric bone age assessments

items.title: Why this startup is taking its AI to predict breast cancer risk directly to patients
items.excerpt: Clairity, whose FDA-authorized mammogram-based breast cancer risk AI lacked physician and insurer uptake, is selling it directly to patients (via Everlywell, $249).

history_match.title: Clairity expands access to AI breast cancer risk tool via Everlywell

items.title: 'AI sandboxes' are all the rage. Advocates scramble to control their future
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: the groups vying to shape the rules for state health-AI regulatory sandboxes, which let AI tools operate in care with relaxed oversight.

history_match.title: Utah approves slew of health AI pilots for drug management, women's health

items.title: Public Perceptions of Timeliness for AI Use and Human Oversight
items.excerpt: Cross-sectional study of public perceptions on using AI for patient-portal messaging and mental health support, weighing faster responses against human oversight, stratified by birth generation. (Online date verified via Crossref.)

items.title: Automated differentiation for parkinsonism using clinical structural MRI: A multicenter study
items.excerpt: A T1-weighted structural MRI-based AI model differentiates Parkinson's disease from multiple system atrophy using routine clinical scans across multiple centers, avoiding costly research-grade multimodal MRI.

history_match.title: AI-assisted telerehabilitation in early Parkinson’s disease: a multicenter, randomized, multi-arm comparative trial

items.title: Artificial intelligence for opportunistic osteoporosis screening on chest radiographs
items.excerpt: AI-OsRM, trained on 46,478 paired chest X-ray and DXA scans, predicts osteoporosis and reduced bone mineral density from routine chest radiographs; performance and clinical utility tested in three external cohorts.

items.title: Infant neurodevelopmental impairment detection via large-scale motion screening with generative learning
items.excerpt: Generative-learning AI screens infant movement videos at scale to detect neurodevelopmental impairments such as cerebral palsy early, enabling timely intervention.

items.title: Voice AI startup careCycle rolls out free plan comparison tool for Medicare beneficiaries
items.excerpt: CareCycle launched a free tool helping Medicare beneficiaries compare plans with yearly cost estimates; it takes no payer payments or commissions and does not sell personal data.
